data.body: SCOPE_DISTINCTION: e407-d35c is the full source attribution parent epic covering: (1) /dso:blame command for per-line attribution, (2) bug investigation integration — fix-bug queries DSO trailers on blamed commits, (3) retro analytics — aggregate data on which skills/agents/models produce the most bugs, (4) review context enrichment — reviewer agent sees what produced the code under review, (5) telemetry log with detailed agent dispatch context. 170b-2ac9 was explicitly extracted as the MVP slice covering commit trailers only (git-native trailer injection via /dso:commit) — see the existing comment 'MVP slice extracted as epic 170b-2ac9'. 170b-2ac9 is now closed; e407-d35c retains the remaining non-trailer attribution scope.
